href.description: Unique href for this action log event, which can be used for event lookup via the events API

event.description: Correlation href identifying the API request / context from which events originated

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 timestamp at which this event was originally created

pce_fqdn.description: Fully qualified domain name of the PCE, where this event originated

created_by.description: The entity responsible for the creation of this event

user.description: The user responsible for the creation of this event

agent.description: The agent responsible for the creation of this event

container_cluster.description: The container_cluster responsible for the creation of this event

event_type.description: Event name that clearly describes the action log event

status.description: Status of the event; usually a mapping of api_status_code to a generic result string. For presentation purposes only.

task_name.description: The name of the timed worker job from which this event originated

api_method.description: Name of API method invoked on some target resource(s)

http_status_code.description: HTTP status code returned from the API call.

src_ip.description: Source IP of the request for which the event was generated. If the request is coming from the PCE itself, then we should log the IP of the PCE.

errors.description: Extra information regarding the reason for failure. This property is only for failure events and will not appear in successful events

info.description: Extra information about the action log event in json format
